text:
maria: Quick question — we need to give contractor @kenji console access to view analytics dashboards in the project for 3 days. What's the least-privilege path? Don't want to open logs or secrets.
access-bot: Access request created: request#12345 for kenji. https://access-redwood.example/req/12345
priya: I'd avoid project-level Viewer. Prefer a custom role limited to dashboards + monitoring.read + traces.read. Avoid granting broad logging permissions that expose raw PII.
kenji: I only need to view dashboards and APM traces, not raw logs. 3 days is fine.
alex: We have a temp role pattern: 'console.temp_analytics_viewer' with perms: monitoring.dashboards.get, monitoring.timeSeries.list, cloudtrace.traces.list. If we must give logging, scope it to just the analytics log name with an IAM Condition.
priya: You can use IAM Conditions to time-limit and restrict by log name. Example gcloud binding (security will review):
```
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding my-redwood-prod
  --member=user:kenji@contractor.com
  --role=projects/my-redwood-prod/roles/console.temp_analytics_viewer
  --condition="title=3d,expression=request.time < timestamp(\"2026-03-20T12:00:00Z\"),description=3-day contractor"
```
maria: Who can create the custom role? eng-platform or security?
alex: eng-platform can create, security reviews. I'll create it and open a PR to infra-roles.
access-bot: Approval needed from eng-security. @priya please review: https://access-redwood.example/review/12345
priya: ACK. Quick checklist: 1) No admin roles; 2) Redact sensitive fields in analytics logs (PII) before granting list access; 3) Time-bound IAM Condition; 4) Ensure audit logging for role grants.
maria: Thanks. @kenji once access is up please confirm you can't view Secret Manager or raw logs.
kenji: Will check and report.
priya: Also require SSO + corp VPN for contractor sessions. Set binding expiry and add a ticket to rotate if extended.
alex: Done — role created and PR opened. Binding applied with expiry. I also added a redact rule for analytics logs and left a note in the ticket.
kenji: Confirmed: I can view dashboards and traces, can't access secretmanager or full log payloads. All good.
maria: Closing this once audit shows grant + revoke events. Thanks all :thumbsup:
access-bot: Request #12345 approved by @priya.
